🏗️ The Three Tiers

The current inventory sorts into three tiers based on access friction, not quality:

Tier 1 Enterprise-Approved
Low risk · Scalable · Preferred. Provisioned centrally. If you have a company login, you have access.
Copilot Chat · GenAI Experience Lab · CompeteGPT · ReferenceGPT · Claude Code · Joule · EKX
Tier 2 Budget-Approved
Moderate control · Department-managed. Requires a budget request and approval. Process is real but not painful.
Perplexity Pro · Comet Browser · Adobe AI · Canva · Synthesia · Copilot in-app (Word/PPT/Teams)
Tier 3 Pilot & Non-Onboarded
Higher risk · Limited visibility · Six-to-nine month onboarding. Watch but don't self-onboard.
Crayon (onboarding) · Writer (in eval) · Clozd · Copy.ai · Beautiful.ai

⚠️ Standing rule across all tiers: No personal or customer data into unapproved tools. No proprietary code in uncleared systems. Always review AI output before sharing.

🤖 Tier 1 Tools (Start Here)

These tools are available now with your SAP credentials. No license request needed.

🧠

EKX

✨ New

The knowledge graph in chat form. Use when the question is "what is the actual current truth about X." Built for enumeration and fact-checking where generic LLMs would fabricate. The only internal LLM that actually knows SAP.

Learn about EKX →
✨

Joule

✅ Available now

Front door for SAP-specific transactions and answers. Use when you need a product feature explained, a customer-facing process guided, or a transactional task completed inside an SAP product. The path customers will see.

Access Joule →
🤖

Microsoft Copilot

✅ Available now

The workhorse. Free, integrated across M365 (Edge browser, M365.com, right-click "Summarize with Copilot" in Explorer). Right default for general-purpose tasks — drafting emails, summarizing meetings, brainstorming structures.

Open Copilot →
⚔️

CompeteGPT

✅ Available now

SAP's internal competitive intelligence tool. Search for competitors to surface win/loss patterns, positioning shifts, and battlecard-ready insights from CRM data.

Access CompeteGPT →
🧪

GenAI Experience Lab

✅ Available now

The playground. Compare answers across foundation models, prototype prompts, try the PowerPoint generator. Data protection built in, multiple LLMs available, iOS app for mobile use.

Open GenAI XL →
💻

Claude Code

✨ Powerful

The wildcard. An agentic coding assistant that reads codebases, edits files, runs commands. Also writes interactive web artifacts, builds React prototypes, generates HTML for battlecards. Worth attention even if you've never opened a terminal.

Learn about Claude Code →

🔑 Tier 2 Tools (Licensed)

These require a budget request but the process is tractable. D&A has allocated licenses for key tools.

🔍

Perplexity Pro

🔑 110 licenses

The research tool. Real-time web answers with citations, rapid scanning of competitor content, triangulating market claims with sources attached. Comet Browser bundled for daily research work.

Open Perplexity →
🎨

Claude

🔑 Licensed

Anthropic's AI assistant. Particularly strong at long-form content, nuanced analysis, and following complex instructions. Great for positioning work and messaging frameworks.

Open Claude →
💬

ChatGPT

🔑 Licensed

OpenAI's flagship assistant. Versatile general-purpose AI for drafting, brainstorming, analysis, and creative tasks. The GPT-4 model handles complex reasoning well.

Open ChatGPT →
🎬

Synthesia

🔑 Licensed

AI video generation with avatars. Create training videos, product explainers, and demo walkthroughs without filming. Good for internal enablement content.

Request access →

⚡ Three Things to Try This Week

Pick one and spend 15 minutes with it. That's all it takes to build the muscle memory.

01

Ask EKX a fact question

"List all SAP products with machine learning capabilities" — get enumeration that generic LLMs would hallucinate.

02

Run a CompeteGPT Query

Search for the competitor you're currently battlecarding. See what win/loss patterns and positioning shifts surface.

03

Try Perplexity with citations

Research a market trend. Note the source citations — they're useful for positioning docs and exec briefings.

📋 Common Use Cases

Not sure where to start? Here's how PMMs are using these tools:

📝 First Drafts

Use ChatGPT or Claude to draft blog posts, email copy, or presentation outlines. Edit from there instead of starting from scratch.

🎯 Competitive Intel

CompeteGPT for internal win/loss data. Perplexity for external market research with cited sources.

✓ Fact-Checking

EKX for SAP-specific enumeration and accuracy. "What products support X?" without hallucination.

📊 Document Summaries

Drop analyst reports, earnings calls, or long PDFs into Copilot or Claude. Get key points in seconds.

💡 Brainstorming

Use any of the chat tools to generate messaging variations, positioning angles, or campaign ideas.

🔧 Interactive Artifacts

Claude Code for HTML battlecards, calculators, interactive demos. No coding experience required.
